records.claim: For 2026 Italy has a defined quota of 76,200 entries for non-seasonal subordinate employment under the 2026-2028 legal-entry programming, alongside separate quotas for self-employment and seasonal employment. The official government immigration portal states that non-seasonal applications use the B2020 model and remain subject to quota availability.
records.sourceAuthority: Italian Government — Portale Integrazione Migranti / Ministry of Interior and partner ministries
records.methodology: Direct review of the official 2026 Flussi government guidance. This is an exact annual non-seasonal subordinate-work quota scope, not a claim that all Italian work authorization routes use the same process.

records.claim: For 2026 non-seasonal subordinate work, the official guidance states that pre-compilation of applications is performed through the ALI Services Portal and applications are submitted from the applicable click-day dates, including 16 February 2026 for non-seasonal subordinate workers and 18 February 2026 for family-care assistance; applications may be submitted through 31 December 2026 subject to quota availability.
records.sourceAuthority: Italian Government — Portale Integrazione Migranti / Ministry of Interior and partner ministries
records.methodology: Direct review of the current 2026 procedural guidance. Dates are recorded as annual operational facts and must not be generalized into a timeless Italy work-visa process.
